function.name: plan_trip
function.description: Plan a Juniper Valley Transit bus trip between two stops or landmarks, using live times. Finds a direct bus or one transfer at Sheridan Transit Center, and says when the next bus leaves and how long the trip takes. Use when a caller asks how to get from one place to another.

to.description: Where the caller wants to go: a stop or landmark, e.g. "Christus St. Vincent hospital", "the Plaza"

from.description: Where the caller is starting: a stop or landmark, e.g. "Santa Fe Place Mall", "the library", "Meow Wolf"
